spans.s:
विमंह् वि-मंह्, cl. 1. A. -मंहते, &c., Ved.
to distribute, bestow.

वि-मंहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. distributing,
giving.

विमज्ज् वि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, &c., to
plunge or dive in, enter into, (probably wrongly for
नि-मज्ज्): Caus. -मज्जयति, &c., to submerge,
cause to plunge into or enter in.
विमत वि-मत, वि-मति. See under वि-मन्.

वि-मत, अस्, आ, अम्, disagreed, disagreeing, dis-
senting, disapproving; at variance, inconsistent, averse,
hostile to; slighted, despised, offended, displeased; of
a different mind or disposition; (अस्), m. an enemy.

वि-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated; being in rut,
ruttish.

विमत्सर वि-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
envy or jealousy, unenvious, unambitious.

विमथ् वि-मथ् or वि-मन्थ्, cl. 1. 9. P. -म-
थति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति (Ved. generally A.
-मथ्नीते), &c., -मथितुम्, -मन्थितुम्, to crush
or dash to pieces, rend asunder, bruise (Ved. A.); to
cut to pieces, annihilate, destroy, disperse, scatter; to
confuse, perplex, bewilder, embarrass.

वि-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or dashed to
pieces, rent asunder, bruised, destroyed, annihilated.

वि-मथ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, dashing to pieces, crush-
ing, destroying.

वि-मथ्य, ind. having crushed completely, having
destroyed.

वि-माथ, अस्, m. the act of crushing or destroy-
ing utterly.

वि-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or dashing to pieces,
destroying.

विमद् वि-मद्, cl. 4. P. -माद्यति (Ved. also
-मदति), &c., -मदितुम्, to become perplexed or
confused, be disconcerted; to confound, embarrass,
disturb: Caus. -मादयति, &c., -यितुम्, to cause to
be perplexed, to confuse, embarrass; to intoxicate.

-26 (having the patronymic Aindra
or Prājāpatya; Vasu-kṛt Vāsukra is also regarded
as the author of these hymns).
वि-मदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), = वि-मत्त.

विमध्य वि-मध्य, Ved. an unfathomable
depth, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

. explains तमसो
विमध्ये by अत्यन्त-गाढान्धकारे, ‘in un-
fathomable darkness.’)

विमन् वि-मन्, cl. 8. 4. A., 1. P. -मनुते,
-मन्यते, -मनति, &c., -मन्तुम्, to distinguish
(?, Ved.); to dishonour, offend: Caus. -मानयति,
-यितुम्, to dishonour, slight, treat with disrespect.

वि-मति, इस्, f. difference of mind or opinion,
dissent, disagreement; dislike, aversion; stupidity.
—विमति-ता, f. difference of opinion, want of mind,
stupidity.

1. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. see under 2.
वि-मा), disrespect, dishonour.

2. वि-मान, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 1. वि-मान see
under वि-मन्), a measure; a car or chariot of the
gods (sometimes serving as a seat or throne, sometimes
self-moving and carrying its occupant through the
skies; other descriptions make the Vimāna more like
a house or palace, and one kind is said to be seven
stories high; that of Rāvaṇa was called पुष्पक,
q. v.); any car or vehicle; a horse; a palace, the
palace of an emperor or supreme monarch.
—विमान-
गमन, अम्, n. ‘going in a car,’ N. of the fifty-
second chapter of the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-
Purāṇa.
—विमान-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, travelling in a
celestial car.
—विमान-ता, f. the state or condition
of a chariot.
—विमान-प्रभुता, f. the ownership
or possession of a celestial chariot.
—विमान-यान,
अस्, आ, अम्, going or driving in a car.
—विमान-राज,
अस्, m. the driver of a chariot of the gods.
—विमान-
वत्, ind. like a self-moving car, (Kirāt.
VII. 4

.)
—वि-
मान-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing on a divine chariot.

1. वि-मान; add — (अस्, आ, अम्), without honour,
dishonoured, disgraced.
वि-मानना, f. dishonour, disrespect, contempt.
विमानना वि-मानना, &c. See col. 2.

वि-मानित, अस्, आ, अम्, dishonoured, slighted,
treated with disrespect.

विमनस् वि-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, changed in
mind or feeling; averse, displeased; out of one's
mind, distraught, depressed in mind or spirit, sad,
distressed, discomposed; heart-broken; absent in
mind, thinking of something else; perplexed, dis-
ordered, bewildered.

वि-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, out of one's mind, de-
pressed in spirit, heart-broken, sad, melancholy, be-
wildered.

विमनी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered in mind or
feeling; displeased, offended; depressed in mind,
sad, sorrowful.

विमनी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become changed in
mind or feeling; brought into a melancholy frame
of mind.
विमन्थ् वि-मन्थ्. See वि-मथ्, col. 1.

विमन्यु वि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from anger
or passion, free from grief.

वि-मन्यु; add — (उस्), m. excessive desire, eager-
ness (Ved.).

विमय वि-मय, अस्, m. (see rt. मे), change,
exchange, barter.

विमाय वि-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of magic,
free from illusion.
विमर्द वि-मर्द, &c. See under वि-मृद्.

वि-मर्द, अस्, m. crushing, bruising; devasta-
tion, destruction, pressing or rubbing together, fric-
tion; the trituration of perfumes; rubbing against,
touch, contact; conjunction of the sun and moon,
total obscuration, eclipse; war, battle; weariness,
tediousness; the plant Cassia Esculenta.
—विमर्-
दार्ध (˚द-अर्˚), अम्, n. the time from the appa-
rent conjunction to the end of an eclipse.
—विमर्-
दोत्थ (˚द-उत्˚), अस्, m. a scent arising from the
trituration of perfumes.
विमर्श वि-मर्श, &c. See under वि-मृश्.

वि-मर्श, अस्, m. consideration, deliberation, in-
vestigation, trial, examination by reason, reasoning,
discussion, hesitation; a conflicting judgment.
—वि-
मर्श-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, uttering discussions, one
who reasons, a reasoner.
विमर्ष वि-मर्ष, &c. See under वि-मृष्.

वि-मर्ष, अस्, m. dissatisfaction, displeasure;
want of forbearance, impatience, (in these senses वि
is privative); change in the prosperous course of a
dramatic plot, unforeseen reverse or adverse event in
the course of a love-story.
—विमर्षाङ्ग (˚ष-
अङ्˚), a division of the dramatic Vimarṣa (of which
there are said to be thirteen).

विमल वि-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, stainless, free
from dirt or impurity, spotless, pure, clean; white,
transparent, beautiful; (अस्), m. an Arhat or Jaina
deified sage; N. of the father of Padma-pāda; of a
son of Su-dyumna; (आ), f. a particular plant, = सप्तला,
(commonly called Charmaghās); a sort of soil; N.
of Dākṣāyaṇī; (अम्), n. silver gilt; talc.
—विमल-
तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.
—विमल-ता,
f. or विमल-त्व, अम्, n. stainlessness, cleanliness,
purity, clearness.
—विमल-दान, अम्, n. a gift or
offering to a deity.
—विमल-नाथ-पुराण, N. of
a Jaina work by Kṛṣṇa-dāsa.
—विमल-प्रभा, f.,
N. of one of the wives of Narendrāditya.
—विमल-
मणि, इस्, m. ‘clear-gem,’ crystal.
—विमलात्मक
(˚ल-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pure-minded, clean, pure.
—वि-
मलात्मन् (˚ल-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, pure-souled, unde-
filed, pure.
—विमलादित्य (˚ल-आद्˚), अस्, m. ‘clear-
sun,’ a particular form of the sun.
—विमलाद्रि (˚ल-
अद्˚), इस्, m. ‘pure mountain,’ N. of the mountain
Vimala or Girnar in Gujarāt, (this mountain is cele-
brated for its inscriptions; it is also called Śatruñ-jaya,
q. v.)
—विमलार्थक (˚ल-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of pure
purpose, pure-minded; pure, clean, clear.
—विम-
[]
लाश्व (˚ल-अश्˚), N. of a country in Kaśmīra.
—विमली-
करण, अम्, n. the act of making pure.
—विमली-
कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make clean or pure.
—विमलेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚ल-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a
chapter in the Śiva-Purāṇa.
विमलोग्य-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work.

विमस्तकित वि-मस्तकित, अस्, आ, अम्, be-
headed, decapitated.

विमहत् वि-महत्, आन्, अती, अत्, very great,
immense.

वि-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of various or excellent
might or splendor, very vigorous, very brilliant or
resplendent.

वि-महि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. very large or great, (Sāy. =
विशेषेण महत्.)

विमा 1. वि-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, &c. (see rt.
2. मा), Ved. to bellow, roar, cry (?).

विमा 2. वि-मा (see rt. 3. मा), cl. 2. P., 3. 4.
A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, (Ved.) to
measure out, to traverse, pass over (a course); (Ved.)
to set in order, set right, prepare; to count, count
over; to measure; to pervade; to make in various
ways.

वि-मिमान, अस्, आ, अम्, measuring out, preparing,
making; measured, conceived, (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda
= विविधम् मिमान.)

विमांस वि-मांस, अस्, अम्, m. n. unclean
meat (as the flesh of dogs &c.).

विमातृ वि-मातृ, ता, f. a stepmother, a fa-
ther's wife.
—विमातृ-ज, अस्, m. a stepmother's son.

विमार्ग वि-मार्ग, अस्, m. a bad road, by-
road; a wrong road (literally or figuratively); evil
conduct, immorality; a broom, brush; [cf. rt. मार्ग्.]
—विमार्ग-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a wrong
road, following an evil course.

वि-मार्गण, अम्, n. the act of searching or seek-
ing for.

विमि वि-मि (see rt. 1. मि), cl. 5. P. A. -मि-
नोति, -मिनुते, -मातुम्, Ved. to fix, build, erect.

वि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed, built; (अम्), n., Ved. a
square shed or large building resting on four posts.

वि-मिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, fixing; (Sāy.) separating
and fixing (= परि-च्छिन्दत् स्थापयत्, Ṛg-veda

विमिश्र् वि-मिश्र्, cl. 10. P. -मिश्रयति, -यि-
तुम्, to mix or mingle together.

वि-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed or mingled together,
commingled.

वि-मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, mingled;
mixed with, attended or accompanied by.
विमुक्त वि-मुक्त, &c. See under 1. वि-मुच्.

वि-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, let loose, liberated;
freed from (with inst. or abl., e. g. पाशैः or पाशे-
भ्यो विमुक्तः, freed from fetters); quitted, aban-
doned; issued from, given vent to; hurled, thrown,
discharged.
—विमुक्त-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having
a loosened throat or voice, raising a loud cry.
—वि-
मुक्त-प्रग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, having loosened reins.

विमुख वि-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face
turned away or cast down, averted; disinclined, op-
posed.
—विमुख-ता, f. or विमुख-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of having the face averted, turning away; dis-
inclination, opposition; disappearance, departure.

विमुखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having the face averted, turned
away; averse from, hostile.
—विमुखि-ता, f. or वि-
मुखि-त्व, अम्, n. a state of aversion, enmity;
opposition; departure.

विमुखी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make the face averted, turn away the face,
turn away from, leave.
—विमुखी-करण, अम्, n.
the act of turning away or averting the face, leaving.
—विमुखी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away from,
averted, departed.

विमुग्ध वि-मुग्ध. See under वि-मुह्
below.

वि-मुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, confused, bewildered,
infatuated.

विमुच् 1. वि-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति,
-ते, -मोक्तुम्, to unloose, loosen, unharness, un-
fasten, untie, release, set free, liberate; to take off
(clothes), undress; to free from (with abl.); to leave
off, stop, cease; to become loose (A.); to yield, re-
linquish, quit, give up, lose; to emit, pour forth, shed,
send forth; to assume, take: Pass. -मुच्यते, to be
loosened, become detached; to be freed from (with
abl. or inst.); to escape; to be deprived of (with
inst.): Caus. -मोचयति, -यितुम्, to loosen, set free,
unfasten, liberate: Desid. -मुमुक्षति, -ते, to wish
to set free, &c.

2. वि-मुच्, क्, क्, क्, one who lets loose or sends
forth, a creator; a deliverer; (क्), m., N. of Prajā-
pati; a cloud, (Sāy. = जल-विमोचक मेघ.)

वि-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, release, remission;
escape, salvation, final emancipation (from all future
existence); separation, parting.
—विमुक्ति-पथ,
अस्, m. the path or way of final emancipation.

2. वि-मुच्य, ind. having let go; having quitted,
quitting, releasing.

वि-मुच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being let loose or
liberated; being poured forth or sent forth.

वि-मुञ्चत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, unloosing, loosen-
ing; shedding, letting fall.

वि-मोक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be let loose or set
free or discharged.

वि-मोचन, अस्, m. one who delivers, a deliverer,
liberator, (Sāy. = पापाद् विमोचयितृ); (अम्), n.
the act of unloosing, liberating, unharnessing, unyok-
ing; liberation, emancipation.
वि-मोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, loosened, liberated, set free.

विमुद्र वि-मुद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unsealed, un-
closed; opened as a bud or flower, budded, blown.

विमुह् वि-मुह्, cl. 4. P. A. -मुह्यति, -ते,
-मोग्धुम् or -मोढुम्, to be confused, become
perplexed or bewildered; to faint away: Caus. -मो-
हयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be confused, disturb,
deprive of consciousness, infatuate, bewilder, lead
astray, bewitch.

वि-मुह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being bewildered or
stupefied, embarrassed.

1. वि-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, confounded, bewildered,
discomposed; beguiled, led astray, seduced, tempted;
foolish.
—विमूढ-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or विमूढ-
धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, foolish-minded, foolish, simple.
—वि-
मूढ-भाव, अस्, m. bewildered state, perplexed
condition, confusion.
—विमूढ-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
bewildered in mind, senseless, unconscious.
—विमू-
ढात्मन् (˚ढ-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, foolish-minded, sense-
less, foolish, beguiled.

2. वि-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, not foolish or infatuated,
wise; (अस्), m. a kind of divine being.

वि-मोहन, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, alluring, seducing,
seductive, bewitching, tempting, fascinating, one who
fascinates, &c.; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of one of the di-
visions of Naraka (see नरक); (अम्), n. the act of
seducing, seduction, temptation, exciting the passions.

वि-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, seduced, bereft of con-
sciousness, beguiled; stupefied, infatuated, bewitched.

विमृज् वि-मृज्, cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि (some-
times also A. -मार्ष्टे), -मार्जितुम्, -मार्ष्टुम्,
to rub off or out, purify, cleanse; to rub, stroke; to
rub dry, wipe off, wipe; to rub on, anoint: Intens.,
Ved. -मामृजीति, to cleanse, purify.

वि-मृज्य, ind. having rubbed or stroked, having
wiped or swept away, &c.

1. वि-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed off, purified,
cleansed, wiped.
—विमृष्ट-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing the colour refined or purified.

2. वि-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, reflected on, considered,
weighed.

विमृद् वि-मृद्, cl. 9. 1. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्-
दति, &c., -मर्दितुम्, to press or crush to pieces,
bruise, pound, trample down, lay waste, devastate,
destroy; to rub together: Caus. -मर्दयति, -यि-
तुम्, to crush to pieces, bruise; to rub.

वि-मर्दक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who crushes or
pounds, a crusher, destroyer, &c.; (अस्), m. pound-
ing, grinding, destroying; rolling; the trituration of
perfumes; the conjunction of the sun and moon,
an eclipse; a proper N.

वि-मर्दन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of grinding,
pounding, crushing, trampling down, rubbing; the
trituration of perfumes; the conjunction of the sun
and moon, an eclipse; destroying, killing.

वि-मर्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed to pieces, bruised,
pounded, broken to pieces, trampled on; rubbed,
anointed; [cf. स्नेह-व्˚.]

वि-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing to pieces, destroy-
ing, removing,

वि-मृदित, अस्, आ, अम्, bruised, ground, pounded;
broken, rubbed.
—विमृदित-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a crushed or broken banner.

वि-मृद्य, ind. having bruised or pounded or
crushed, having trampled upon; having rubbed.

विमृश् वि-मृश् (often confounded with वि-
मृष्, q. v.), cl. 6. P. -मृशति, -मर्ष्टुम्,
-म्रष्टुम्, to touch (with the hands), feel, stroke,
rub; to touch (mentally), be sensible of, be aware
of, perceive; to ponder, meditate, consider, reflect on,
deliberate about; to observe; to investigate, examine;
to think about with hesitation, hesitate about doing
anything (with inf.): Caus. -मर्शयति, -यितुम्, to
ponder, reflect on, consider.

विमृष् वि-मृष् (in many passages where this
verb occurs the forms used may equally be referred
to वि-मृश्), cl. 1. 4. P. A. -मर्षति, -ते, -मृष्-
यति, -ते, -मर्षितुम्, to bear with indifference.

वि-मर्शन, अम्, n. the act of investigating, dis-
cussing, investigation.

वि-मर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, deliberating, thinking about,
reflecting.

वि-मर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disliking, dissatisfied, averse;
impatient, intolerant.

वि-मृशत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, reflecting, con-
sidering, musing.

1. वि-मृश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deliberated about
or investigated, to be discussed or reflected upon.
